subject: SOC 2 Type II — targeted authn samples, bridge window & sampling plan
body_messages:
From: security@summithealth.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: auditor_team@brightaudit.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — targeted samples and bridge window

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the meeting last week. As part of our procurement review we need your SOC 2 Type II report and a small set of targeted control samples for authentication (to satisfy our internal auditors). Specifically, can you provide:

- SOC 2 Type II report covering the period Feb 1, 2027 — Jul 31, 2027 (PDF)
- A bridge letter if the report does not fully cover our contract start date
- Narrowed sample slices (CSV or text) for:
  * MFA enforcement events (enrollment + recent challenge failures)
  * Privileged access reviews (snapshots of recertification activity)
  * Keystore/secret rotation logs (rotation events and approver)
  * Short window of auth logs showing an SSO sign-in + device context (redact PII)

We're aiming to complete the security review by Sep 1. Auditor (BrightAudit) is copied — they'll ingest the artifacts. If you can confirm scope and expected delivery dates, we can align our internal audit calendar.

Also, if you need a specific extraction format or any trusted third-party upload (SFTP/Drive/DocuSign for confidentiality agreements), let us know.

Appreciate it —
Maya Singh
Security Program Manager
SummitHealth

---
Attachment: request_template.xlsx (spreadsheet with example columns)
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
To: security@summithealth.com
Cc: auditor_team@brightaudit.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — targeted samples and bridge window

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can absolutely provide the SOC 2 Type II and the targeted artifact slices. Quick notes and proposed plan: 

1) Report + bridge letter
   - We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2027-02-01 to 2027-07-31. I will attach the report summary and draft bridge letter for your review this week. Final bridge letter requires sign-off from Legal (we can turn that around in 3 business days once you confirm the language).

2) Targeted slices (scope and redaction)
   - MFA events: we'll provide a CSV with event timestamp, user_id (hashed), event_type (enroll/challenge/failure), method (TOTP/Push), and note if a policy override occurred.
   - Access reviews: we can provide snapshots (exported CSV) of the last two quarterly recertifications for privileged groups. These will indicate approver and outcome; we will redact email addresses to hashed ids per your request.
   - Keystore rotations: rotation event log (timestamp, key_id, rotated_by, rotation_type). For safety we will not include key material.
   - Authn log window: we propose a 48-hour sample window (UTC 2027-07-20 00:00 to 2027-07-21 23:59) for SSO sign-ins with device context; fields will be limited to hashed user_id, time, app, idp, device_type, geo-country.

3) Delivery and upload options
   - Preferred: secure Share (temporary link) in our vendor drive (we'll send link); alternative SFTP if you prefer.

Proposed timeline:
- Aug 18: draft bridge letter + SOC2 summary (we will share the draft bridge for your review)
- Aug 20: initial authn slices & manifest (CSV)
- Aug 25: final artifacts delivered to secure link (after internal review & redaction)

I've looped in Olga (Security Ops) and Neha (Compliance) to assist with extraction and redaction. Karthik from Engineering can help with keystore rotation logs if needed. If that timeline works I will move forward and schedule short extraction tasks with the team.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf (summary, not full report)
From: security@summithealth.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: auditor_team@brightaudit.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — targeted samples and bridge window

Thanks Aisha — this plan looks good. A few clarifications from our side before you extract: 

- The 48-hour window for authn logs is fine. For privacy we prefer hashed user identifiers and no IP addresses. Device_type and geo-country is sufficient.
- For keystore rotation, we only need metadata (no secrets); include approver and rotation reason if available.
- For access review snapshots, please include which entitlement catalog (group names) the snapshot maps to — helps our auditors map to control narratives.

If you can get the draft bridge letter and summary on Aug 18 as proposed, BrightAudit can start ingesting and let us know if they need additional context. We'll plan to finish our review by Sep 1.

One small ask — can you include a short manifest CSV that lists each artifact (filename, type, time window, redaction notes)? That will speed ingestion.

Thanks —
Maya Singh
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II — targeted samples and bridge window / extraction tasks

Folks — forwarding SummitHealth's ask and the proposed timeline. Action items: 

- Olga: can you take lead on extracting the MFA event slice and the 48-hour authn log window. Requirements: hashed user_id (sha256), no IP addresses, include device_type and geo-country. Output a CSV and a short manifest CSV describing redaction and tool used.
- Neha: lead access review snapshots for privileged groups (two most recent recertifications). Include group name mapping and approver. Redact emails to hashed ids.
- Karthik: provide keystore rotation metadata (rotation timestamps, key_id, rotated_by) and a short note on rotation reason if recorded. No key material.

Deadline: initial slice + manifest by EOD Aug 20, final delivery Aug 25. SummitHealth needs the draft bridge letter and SOC2 summary by EOD Aug 18 — that I will send separately. If you foresee any blocker (retention window concerns or needing PR approvals), flag immediately.

Thanks —
Aisha

   - Karthik to provide rotation metadata; I will merge into the manifest.
